newsitem.title: CANADA: Breakwater buys El Toqui from Barrick.
newsitem.headline: Breakwater buys El Toqui from Barrick.

text.p: Breakwater Resources Ltd said on Monday it agreed to acquire the El Toqui zinc and gold mine in Chile from Barrick Gold Corp for US$6 million plus working capital.
Breakwater said it would also pay an escalating net smelter return royalty to start at 1 percent when the London Metal Exhange (LME) price of zinc hits U.S.$0.50 a pound or higher.
The return royalty increases to a maximum of 3 percent if the LME price goes to US$0.60 a pound.

The El Toqui property contains a 1,100 tonne a day concentrating plant and a hydroelectric power generating plant. It also includes the currently producing Dona Rosa zinc mine and the formerly producing San Antonoio and Mallin-Monica zinc mines.
Breakwater estimated on June 30 the mineable reserves at Dona Rosa to be 1.7 million tonnes, averaging 8.8 percent zinc and 1.5 grams of gold per tonne.
